events.title: WMCC Youth Program
events.audience: Ages 14–25 · brothers and sisters meet separately
events.description: A monthly gathering for Muslim youth to grow in faith, build real friendships and feel at home in the community. Every night has Islamic knowledge, open discussion, activities and good food, in a space grounded in brotherhood and sisterhood. Dates are posted on Instagram.

events.title: Jumu'ah Prayer
events.description: Weekly Friday khutbah at 1:00 PM followed by prayer. Iqama is at 1:30 PM.

events.title: Monthly Halaqa
events.description: Join us for our monthly halaqa where we discuss different Islamic topics and how to apply them in daily life. All community members are welcome.

events.title: Community Dinner
events.description: A monthly meal together as a community. Bring a dish to share, or just bring yourself.

events.title: Islamic Sunday School
events.description: Quran, Islamic Studies, Seerah, Arabic and Public Speaking taught by volunteer teachers from our community.

events.title: Ladies Quran Class
events.description: A weekly Quran class for our sisters, focused on recitation, tajweed and understanding.

events.title: Hifz Class
events.description: Memorization of the Holy Quran with proper tajweed and understanding.

events.title: Sisters Book Club
events.description: Sisters pick a book to read together. At each meeting they discuss the last book and choose the next one.
